title: Gen output coverage: voices and length for Audio, and 3D wired or dropped from the copy
gap: With a speech model, Gen › Audio always shows 'Choose a voice.' (lib/workspace/composer.ts:391) because GenView has no voice control; only the legacy components/workspace/GenerateComposer.tsx:200 has one, and composer.audio.voices is already loaded. Music and SFX are fixed at 10 s and instrumental with no controls. The connected catalogue supports '3d' (lib/higgsfield-consumer/catalogue.ts:15, stored as 'model'), but COMPOSER_TYPES is image/video/audio while the copy promises 3D.
target: The Audio tab gets a voice picker (composer.audio.voices → dispatch 'voice'), a seconds stepper ('seconds') and an Instrumental toggle ('instrumental'). Add a 3D tab for owners on connected billing using the existing '3d' type, with results filed as 'model' assets. Until that ships, remove '3D' from the hint and the tile.
respects_rules: Reuses the existing reducer actions and connected types, each priced on the button.
